description.text: One-year Chinese Language Training Program for Chinese learners Courses: Basic Chinese; Chinese Listening; Oral Chinese; Chinese Culture; Comprehensive Chinese; Chinese Writing Teaching Texts: Boya Chinese; Chinese Elementary Listening Course; Elementary Spoken Chinese; Chinese Reading Comprehension; Chinese Culture; Chinese History; Chinese Geography Duration of Teaching: 20 classes per week; 30 weeks per year Fee Standard: 16000 RMB per year Upon completion of each program, learners will get certificates of study issued by School of International Education. Admission Fee: RMB 200 per person, paid at the time of application. Registration fee: RMB 200 per person, paid at the beginning of each school year. Miscellaneous Fee: RMB 4000 for the first year, and RMB 2500 for each following year. (Miscellaneous fee contains the fees for books, teaching materials, insurance, physical examination, residence permit, etc.) Accommodation Fee: for two-bed room is : 600 RMB / month (double room); 400 RMB / month (triple room)
